title: Hatsune Miku — The SEKAI Dressing Room Is This Way♪〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: The SEKAI Dressing Room Is This Way♪（4★）

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's do our best during this inventory check, everyone!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I should be able to mend any outfits with loose stitching or buttons if you bring them to me.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's amazing. I didn't know you could sew, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: No, I only have some basic knowledge.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm thinking that we can ask Shizuku about any that prove to be more of a challenge and hand them over to her if necessary.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. Shizuku's a talented seamstress in her own right♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, KAITO, I'll bring any that I think need some attention to you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Shall we get started♪

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hmm... This outfit...
Looks okay... Next is...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hm? The stitching on the sleeve for this one's coming loose on the inside... It's not immediately obvious, but I suppose it's worth mending...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, the shoulder decorations on this one are drooping a bit.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, KAITO, can you fix stuff like this?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Mind if I take a look?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The stitching for both the decorations and the outfit itself appears to be coming loose. I should be able to mend this.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really?! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
This one seems fine.
The next should be in the back... Wah!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Miku?
Oh, did your hair get caught in the other outfits?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes, I think so.
Can you untangle me, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Of course. Stay still for me, okay?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: KAITO, I found some loose threads on this one too...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Uh, KAITO...?
Are you under this pile of outfits?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I think he is.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Unfortunately, more outfits than I expected need mending. I started using my lap after I ran out of space and this happened...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Well, there are quite a few with only very minor damage...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
True...
But I kinda want them mended since we never get this kind of opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I agree. Let me give you a hand, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Especially considering that I was the one who brought up this idea.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I'll join you.
I should have the dexterity to help out somehow.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Thank you both very much!
Alright, let me give you a quick rundown.

rows.Speaker: Miku & Len
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Tie it off tightly and...
Done!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
How's this, KAITO?
I tried restitching it after getting to pattern on the fabric to line back up...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Wow! You did a wonderful job, Miku!
You deserve a 100 for this.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really?! Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Nice job, Miku.
How does mine look, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, it looks good!
You've both done a fantastic job.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. That's because you're such a good teacher, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright, let's keep this up and mend away!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hey, you three.
You've been at it for a while now. How does a quick break sound?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I can keep going.
If anything, I'm actually having a lot of fun right now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You are? I didn't know you liked to sew, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There's that...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: These outfits play a big role in letting me shine as an idol. That's why I'm really happy about getting this opportunity to tell them, “Thank you.”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Still, they do play a big role in letting an idol shine...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I feel something similar.
It's like putting one of these on gives me the confidence I need to be the idol that I am.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, I know what you mean.
These outfits make it easier for me to switch between being an idol and a manager.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Really?
Hmm... What do my outfits do for me...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, I know...
Not only do these give me confidence, but they're also able to lend me their power somehow♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: When I'm wearing one of these, I feel like I can shake off my nerves by telling myself, “You can do it!” or “I believe in you!”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Now that you mention it, Rin, your eyes and smile always sparkle when you're in one of these outfits.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What about you two, Luka, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Me? I'd say my outfits give me an extra dash of spice♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Similar to how Miku said her outfits give her the ability to shine as an idol.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Spice, huh? That does sound nice!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
For me... My outfit is my partner.
I can't go on stage as an idol without it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa! MEIKO, that's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's interesting to compare and contrast how we all see our outfits.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, I'm glad we had this talk.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But in the end, we're idols and can't do anything without these outfits.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's keep cherishing them to make sure we're able to spread and inspire hope in others♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, everyone, let's continue. There's just a little bit more to go with our inventory check.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!
